exposure: Type 2 Diabetes (preexisting T2DM vs. newly recognized T2DM)
Cardiometabolic risk factors (smoking, chronic hypertension, dyslipidemia, obesity)
cohort: The cohort included 1297 pregnancies in women with Type 2 Diabetes who gave birth to a live infant after 24 weeks of gestation in Denmark between 2004 and 2019.
finding: Cardiometabolic risk factors are prevalent in pregnant women with Type 2 Diabetes and are significantly associated with severe adverse obstetric and perinatal outcomes for both mother and child.
